partners.mechanism_chain: LRAT (HGNC:6726) —DISRUPTS→ Retinoid metabolism (R-HSA-1908509); Retinoid metabolism (R-HSA-1908509) —LEADS_TO→ Xeroderma pigmentosum (HP:0000965); MYO7A (HGNC:7709) —DISRUPTS→ Hair cell stereocilia development and maintenance (GO:0001721); Hair cell stereocilia development and maintenance (GO:0001721) —LEADS_TO→ Deafness (HP:0000365); Hair cell stereocilia development and maintenance (GO:0001721) —LEADS_TO→ Vestibular dysfunction (HP:0001251); MYO7A (HGNC:7709) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000549). Loss-of-function mutations in LRAT disrupt retinoid metabolism, leading to the phenotypes of congenital xeroderma pigmentosum. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in MYO7A disrupt hair cell stereocilia development and maintenance, causing deafness and vestibular dysfunction, and also contribute to retinal degeneration seen in Usher syndrome type 1B. While MYO7A is involved in photoreceptor structure, LRAT's role in retinoid metabolism is critical for the visual cycle, indicating a convergence on visual system integrity.

partners.diseaseBName: progressive retinal dystrophy due to retinol transport defect
partners.mechanism_chain: LRAT (HGNC:6733) —DISRUPTS→ Retinol esterification (GO:0000031); RBP4 (HGNC:9869) —DISRUPTS→ Retinol transport (GO:0006879); Retinol esterification (GO:0000031) —DECREASES→ Retinol esters (CHEBI:17550); Retinol transport (GO:0006879) —DECREASES→ Retinol esters (CHEBI:17550); Retinol esters (CHEBI:17550) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal retinal morphology (HP:0007772); Retinol esters (CHEBI:17550) —LEADS_TO→ Retinitis pigmentosa (HP:0000542); Retinol esters (CHEBI:17550) —LEADS_TO→ Xerophthalmia (HP:0001177). Loss-of-function mutations in LRAT disrupt retinol esterification, leading to decreased production of functional retinol esters. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in RBP4 disrupt retinol transport, also contributing to reduced levels of functional retinol esters. The deficiency in retinol esters impairs retinal function and morphology, manifesting as retinitis pigmentosa and abnormal retinal morphology, and can also lead to xerophthalmia.
